episodes.199114: An upper-level low approached the lower Mississippi valley the morning of March 9, with a stationary surface front situated across Central Alabama. During the day, several thunderstorms were able to move eastward or northeastward along or south of the boundary, which was positioned just north of Montgomery. Just before 1 PM CDT, a cell moved through northern Autauga and Elmore counties, producing nickel-size hail in the Marbury area.
episodes.199144: Winds were shifting east-northeast to the east as a frontal boundary dissipated north of the region. Although a mid-to-upper-level ridge was building aloft, local effects (geographic and sea breeze variations) led to the formation of showers over the mountains and western Puerto Rico, where they reported the funnel cloud.
episodes.199719: Severe thunderstorms produced large hail over Polk and San Jacinto counties.
episodes.200168: A slow moving frontal boundary brought multiple rounds of showers and thunderstorms to the area. Isolated flash flooding occurred along with hail and isolated wind damage.
episodes.200354: A dynamic weather pattern as a front slowly edged south across SE GA as a wave of low pressure tracked eastward along the low under strong upper-level lift. The warm sector of this system was across NE FL where isolated strong storms produced gusty winds. Locally heavy rainfall impacted parts of SE GA and NE FL where daily totals neared 3 inches.

episodes.200929: An upper disturbance and cold front moved across the region. Scattered convection was associated with the system, but one storm became severe. Behind the cold front, strong north winds drove tides below normal.
episodes.201159: A cold front draped across the southern half of the country was moving south through central Louisiana and Mississippi on March 8th. Warm moist southerly flow was increasing as this boundary approached due to lowering surface pressures. Thunderstorms developed in the warm sector over the northern Gulf ahead of the front. One storm passing over a buoy produced a severe wind gust.
episodes.201203: A severe storm produced large hail in southwest Alabama.
episodes.201381: A round of severe weather impacted a portion of the south and southeast areas with swaths of wind damage, some significant, as a supercell storm tracked across the area late during the evening of the 8th. Additional storms developed during the morning hours of the 9th and produced hail.
